reasons: The inserted subsection (c) supplies every atomic element of the preferred warranty: professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day Services conformance measured from performance or completion, 12-month conformance for the Site, deliverables and software, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and the repair/replace/refund remedy set.

The clause was wholly absent (Section 9 contained only mutual authority warranties and the Globix carve-out), so a single concise inserted subsection is the minimal fix; no existing sentence was altered and no extra exceptions, definitions or boilerplate were added.
Intent preserved: subsections (a) and (b) remain fully effective, the inserted text uses existing defined terms (HDI, Company, Site, Services) and creates no contradiction or dangling mechanic.
